source_text: Tribui Levi non dedit hereditatem; Dominus hereditas eius. Sacerdotium non fundos quaerit sed Dominum.
pass_a_gloss: To-tribe Levi not he-gave inheritance; Lord inheritance his. Priesthood not estates seeks but Lord.
pass_b_english: [[To Levi he gave no inheritance; the Lord is his inheritance >> Bible:Joshua 13:14]]. Priesthood seeks not estates but the Lord.
